summary: FD_ED_TC_15_Passenger | Group Booking 15 Pax | Individual Claim Only | Other Pax Not Displayed
title: Passenger | Group Booking 15 Pax | Individual Claim Only | Other Pax Not Displayed
description:
PNR is a group booking with 15 passengers. Per call transcript: "For group bookings, each passenger must submit their claim individually, and Agentic should not present other passengers in the group booking during the claim process." System must detect group booking identifier, NOT display other passengers, and allow only individual claim.

Prerequisites:
PNR: TCED15; Group booking (15 pax); Group booking identifier PRESENT in Trip Tracer (Group ID: GRP-2026-0525); Customer: "Ahmed Hassan" (1 of 15 passengers)
